description:
Update a chatbot

Changes one or more fields on a chatbot. Every field is optional, but the body must contain at least one recognised field: an empty object is rejected with 400. `enableVoice` switches the widget microphone, `voiceId` changes the voice and an empty `voiceId` returns to the engine default; the chosen voice is kept while the microphone is off. The older `textOnlyMode` is still read as the inverse of `enableVoice`. The change is pushed to the voice engine first and then stored; if the engine rejects the push the request still succeeds and the new values are stored, so verify the chatbot afterwards when live behaviour matters. The response is a confirmation message only, not the updated chatbot.

body.description: The fields to change. At least one must be present.

allowedDomains.description: Hostnames allowed to embed this widget (Referer-checked, fail-closed). Empty/omitted = unrestricted.

chatbotDisplayName.description: Display name shown in the chat widget

enableVoice.description: Switches the widget microphone on or off. The chosen voice is kept while it is off.

language.description: Primary language for the chatbot (ISO 639-1). Affects NLP and default greetings.

supportedLanguages.description: All languages the chatbot can converse in, as ISO-639-1 codes. First element = primary language.

systemPrompt.description: System instructions for the chatbot behavior

teaserMessage.description: Marketing hook shown in the proactive teaser bubble before the visitor opens the chat. Independent from `greeting`. Empty = no teaser bubble.

textOnlyMode.description: Deprecated: the inverse of `enableVoice`, kept for clients written against 1.12. Ignored when `enableVoice` is present.

voiceId.description: The voice the chatbot speaks with, from GET /voices or GET /voices/available. An empty string returns to the engine default voice.

widgetLanguage.description: Overrides the widget UI chrome language (buttons, placeholders, aria-labels), independent of the conversation `language`. Empty/omitted = automatic, follows `language`.
